items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were getting ready to go and do one thing with him in Boston, do a concert with him. We did, and that was fun.

ctx.x: Did you ever record on organ?
Oh yeah, you know. I did some things on the Tribute to Ray Charles. I did a little stuff on there.
There‘s a question now that I want to ask you that‘s pretty sensitive, so, well, you‘ll tell me anyway. I was going to say, so you just tell me if you don‘t want to deal with it, but you‘ll tell me.
